purpose: Small probe: existing prediction values enter action(step, expect=, read=) and a mismatch stops the suffix
game_source: Three familiar development games: the prediction-mismatch case, a click game that already names pred, and a full-win control
budget_formula: Equal 600-second windows over 3 games; an adoption probe, not a 12-game score trial
selection_note: Success is the chain itself: expect, one action, comparison, stop, and a later repair. Zero checked_trace calls pauses this route. Do not answer that with a longer prompt or more games.
comparison_note: Same 3 IDs, 600s each arm, one pass, no warmup, baseline remaining/pace0. Candidate only accepts action(step, expect=already_computed, read=existing_reader) and records checked_trace. No region API, FP8, or probe budget. Scores explain cost and false stops; they are not a promotion gate.
